question: What characterizes a person who merely mocks the Kula scripture?
premises: Such a person is driven by greed
Such a person is always fickle
This behavior amounts to mockery of the Kula scripture
inference: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle makes a mockery of the Kula scripture.
uncertainties: The grammatical agreement of capalā with the subject is slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
